summary: NICE Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing a joint solution with ServiceNow to integrate its CXone AI platform with ServiceNow Customer Service Management and workflow capabilities. The filing is a routine business development press release, not a special situation. No terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are provided. This is a product announcement, not a merger, acquisition, or other transformative event. The registrant is the issuer reporting this operational update as required under Rule 13a-16.
